from openpyxl import load_workbook
import os

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/463-17/1_463-17_init.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/463-17_0_50ea0fa7/1_463-17_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Build repeated company-name list from columns A and B
repeated_names = []
row = 2
while True:
    company = ws[f"A{row}"].value
    count = ws[f"B{row}"].value
    
    if company is None and count is None:
        # Continue scanning a bit in case of blank rows, but stop after the used range
        if row > ws.max_row:
            break
    elif company is not None and count is not None:
        repeated_names.extend([company] * int(count))
    
    row += 1
    if row > ws.max_row + 10:
        break

# Fill D2:D46 with the resulting list
for i in range(45):
    ws[f"D{2 + i}"] = repeated_names[i] if i < len(repeated_names) else None

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
